reviewer: Kimi actually viewed the exact original 65x67 source, source-only NEAREST upper-note and right-tab crops, unchanged mascot identity reference, complete external-08 raw PNG and full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha sheet. Native upper-note crop (1120,940,650,240) and right-tab crop (1550,1060,470,430) were viewed at original resolution. The extra upper-middle group is removed and the lower two groups remain, but the upper-right group remains too long and the tab remains a tall vertical block rather than the source's compact horizontally protruding tab. Checked task/prompt/request/result, ordered input and separately transmitted mask bindings.

remaining_reasons: The independent upper-middle bar is removed and exactly two upper groups remain, but the retained upper-right group is still an overly long continuous bar, substantially longer than the upper-left group. The source's two upper gray-mark groups have compact comparable footprints and closer source-relative spacing. Restore the upper-right group's compact irregular shape and source-relative length without recreating an extra middle group; retain the lower row's two groups and blank lower paper.

The tab is shorter than external-07 but is still a tall vertical dark rectangle, taller than it is wide. The exact source and NEAREST detail show a compact horizontally protruding tab at the right note edge, wider than its visible height. Restore that compact horizontal outline, scale and position rather than merely shortening the previous tall block.

hair_features.reason: The receding crown, short gray-brown side/back hair and sideburns, dark brows and clean-shaven chin are retained without glasses or an invented beard.

collar_fit.reason: The white pointed shirt collar and dark tie retain a short broad fitted transition, with no pinched collar, floating cloth, long neck column or cream bib.

entries.positive_observation: The yellow compact mascot retains green-ringed black eyes, short gray-brown side/back hair, dark brows, one stern mouth, a viewer-left pose, dark suit, white shirt and dark tie. The upper row now has two separated groups and the lower row retains two groups. The photographic frame/backplate and largely blank lower note remain, with no newly invented readable writing or extra people.
entries.alpha_decision: Native RGBA is 2048x2048 with extrema 0..254. Counts are 0=1790322, 252=580897, 253=1720410, 254=577 and 255=0. The complete white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha comparisons show the opaque person, photographic backing, frame and note, with no visible interior holes or lost backing. Internal 252-254 values alone are not rejection grounds. The visible RGB note proportions and tab shape nevertheless reject this output; no alpha-only substitution or production import is authorized.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine individual note-stroke endpoints, tie weave and readable glyph identities cannot be resolved at 65x67. Rejection relies on plainly visible upper-group relative lengths and the vertical-versus-horizontal tab shape, not guessed text.
